parse_webhook_payload: parse a HuggingFace webhook JSON payload into a WebhookPayload Pydantic model instance
validate_webhook_event: validate a webhook event payload to confirm it matches the expected action and scope fields
extract_repo_info: extract repository metadata including owner, name, type, and URL from a WebhookPayloadRepo object
inspect_discussion_details: inspect discussion or pull request details including status, title, and author from a WebhookPayloadDiscussion object
check_webhook_version: check that a webhook payload uses the supported webhook version 3
